## Purpose

WideEP **2P2D DP16** MoRIIO **WRITE** GSM8K stalls at `num_concurrent` when requests land on child-pod ranks (DP 8–15).

The toy proxy pins `remote_dp_rank` and `X-data-parallel-rank`, but does not set `remote_dp_rank_override`. Notify host/port also come from `request_id`, which embeds only the master-pod ZMQ address. If `remote_hosts` / `remote_dp_size_local` are omitted on the request, child-rank notify lands on the master IP with an unfolded port.

title: [Perf][HiSparse] Avoid repeated prefix scans and residency updates
body_opening:
HiSparse's scheduler rescans the entire computed prefix on every materialization call, including pages already known to be durable. Each resident cache group also invokes the same shared materialization and residency operations. With 20 resident groups and hundreds of requests per rank, this consumed most of a scheduler CPU core and delayed workers before their DP collective.

This patch starts scanning at `max(ready_prefix_pages, importing_pages)` and invokes the shared operations only from the first resident manager. It preserves pending-write checks, holes beyond the durable prefix, spill budgets, import completion, and publication ordering. No serving configuration, routing, graph policy

title: [BugFix] Report correct cached_tokens for disaggregated prefill
body_opening:
In disaggregated prefill, the decode node receives KV blocks for the full
  prompt but cannot tell prefix-cache hits from freshly computed tokens.
  _update_waiting_for_remote_kv sets num_cached_tokens = num_computed_tokens,
  so cached_tokens is always prompt_tokens - 1 regardless of real hits.

  When kv_transfer_params carries remote_num_cached_tokens from the prefill
  node, use it; fall back to the old behavior otherwise. Also clamp
  local_cache_hit with max(0, ...) since num_cached_tokens may now be
  smaller than num_external_computed_tokens on the decode node.
